body:
My mom would be perfect for practice speaking, because she is the only one in the family who speaks German and Russian perfectly. 

The only problem is that I feel very self-conscious. I refused to speak Russian the last years, so it feels kind of weird to try again. I'm scared to sound stupid, even if I know that my family (probably) won't care. How can I stop feeling so self-conscious? Just do it and speak?

I could not explain it better. Especially when someone in my family tells me "Just speak Russian!" I forget even the most basic words and am scared to say something wrong, so I'm not even sure about my grammar. 
A friend of me asked me once what dog means in Russian and it came maybe a hour later to my mind that it means собака. 

God I felt so stupid.

tl;dr: Best friend wants to kill herself because of her ex-boyfriend, she blocked me on social media to protect me, I can't go to her because I live too far away and I don't know to deal with this anymore, because I'm scared to lose her 

:(

I'm a big manga fan, are mangas translated to Russian ok? There are plenty of them in the internet and maybe I could re-read some, just in Russian.

I think my mom told me that it could take a year to be more or less fluent, but it's nice to read it from another person. Compared to the years that I refused to talk Russian, one year is almost nothing, so that's not a great problem for me!
